definition.typeAwareRule: Acoustic/classical require separately confirmed top/back/sides woods; electric/bass require the confirmed body material instead. All categories still require body shape, neck, fretboard, string count, fret count, scale, pickups, electronics and bridge. No absent value is inferred to be None or not applicable.
definition.scaleRule: A positive confirmed scaleMm or scale in inches satisfies the single scale requirement.
definition.knownAbsenceRule: An explicit source-backed None for electronics/pickups is a known fact; null or an empty string is unknown.
definition.verificationStatusRule: dataStatus is reported separately and is not used as a substitute for field completeness.
